geometry: All 246 updated main-route and 24 station-approach coordinates preserved in order. Displayed pin positions come from the owner map. Small visual leader lines separate adjacent controls without moving coordinates.
editorialDecisions: Six numbered markets match the official six-market list and existing guide numbering. Numbers identify places, not an imposed itinerary order.
Place des Martyrs de la Resistance and Place du Marche aux Fruits remain on the mapped path but are not labeled as additional official Christmas markets.
The owner's START HERE pin is labeled Join the Walk near Dominicains because the actual line begins near Champ de Mars and ends at Parking Rapp.
Four photo viewpoints: Koifhus steps, canal, Colmar sign and Maison des Têtes. Maison des Têtes uses the named 2025 original from the owner archive; the portrait is displayed uncropped.
Station, both car parks, covered food market, groceries, Saint-Martin and Place Rapp fairground retained. Grocery business name and seasonal opening hours are not inferred.

WC areas added on 2026-10-16 at the owner request using toilet symbols on page 2 of the official 2026 English market map. Area pins reuse nearby owner landmarks; Place de la Sinn is estimated from the printed map. All seven are explicitly approximate, not verified entrances. Hours, fees and accessibility are unconfirmed.
Distance labels are computed from the owner's route vertices, rounded to 0.1 km. The station approach is additional, not included in the main-walk distance.
Original 2023 filmed routes and individual video pages are unchanged. No external Google map edits or publishing performed.
routeRefresh: 2026-10-14: Re-imported the smoothed route from the public map. Main route now 4.894 km; station approach remains 0.817 km. The export also includes the Maison des Têtes pin and image links; website photo selections are unchanged.
